2. The service

SparkScribe turns audio and video files into transcripts in your browser (your audio isn't uploaded) and, if you choose, creates summaries, notes, study material and answers from the transcript text using AI. Saving transcripts and using AI features require a free account. Features may change; we'll try to give notice of significant changes.

Fair-use limits. To keep the service free and sustainable, AI features have usage limits per account (per hour and per month) and a service-wide daily cap. When a limit is reached, the app tells you when you can continue. We may adjust limits. To confirm: whether limits are published as numbers

The Free plan includes [60 minutes] a month To confirm. Allowances measure the length of recordings you transcribe and save; AI features, exports and opening old recordings don't use time.
  • Payment: handled by Stripe. We never see or store your card details. Subscriptions renew automatically each month until cancelled.
  • Upgrades: take effect immediately; Stripe shows any prorated amount before you confirm.
  • Cancellation: at any time in Plan & usage → Manage Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for, then you return to Free. Nothing in your library is deleted.
  • Failed payments: Stripe retries; you keep access during retries, and if payment can't be collected you return to Free.

3. Your account

Keep your password secure and your email address current. You're responsible for activity in your account. You can delete your account at any time in Settings; deletion is immediate and permanent.

4. Your content

You keep all rights to your recordings, transcripts and the material created from them ("your content"). You give us permission to store, process and transmit your content only as needed to provide the service to you, including sending transcript text to our AI provider when you use AI features. We don't use your content to train AI models.

You're responsible for your content and for having the right to record, upload and transcribe it, including consent from the people recorded where the law requires it. Legal review

5. Acceptable use

Don't use SparkScribe to: break the law or others' rights (including privacy and recording-consent laws); record people secretly where that's unlawful; process content you aren't allowed to; attempt to access other accounts or our systems without permission; overload, scrape or reverse-engineer the service or get around usage limits (for example with many accounts or automated requests); or use AI features to create harmful, deceptive or illegal material. Our AI provider's usage policies also apply to AI features. To confirm: link Anthropic's usage policy

6. AI output

AI-generated summaries, notes, quizzes, drafts and answers can be incomplete or wrong, and transcription can mishear words or speakers. Check important information against the recording before relying on it, especially for legal, medical, financial or academic decisions.

7. Availability and changes

We provide SparkScribe "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running and your data safe, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted service, and AI features may be paused at busy times. Export anything you can't afford to lose. Legal review

8. Suspension and termination

We may suspend or close accounts that break these Terms or put the service or other users at risk; where reasonable, we'll tell you why first. You may stop using SparkScribe and delete your account at any time.
